# `item` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "item" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/item/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique item id, e.g. "oil-flask". Stable once shipped (saves). |
| `notes` | string | required | What the item is for, for designers and review. |
| `nameKey` | string | — | Localisation key of the display name; absent = "item.<id>.name". |
| `descKey` | string | — | Localisation key of the description; absent = "item.<id>.desc". |
| `name` | string | — | English display name until the string tables land (the inventory screen, mw-e17.10); absent = a readable form of the id. |
| `description` | string | — | English flavour text the inventory card shows (room for a joke), until the string tables land. |
| `icon` | string | required | Inventory icon asset id (style bible §15.1); a placeholder until the art lands. |
| `value` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Base price in gold (merchants adjust it, mw-e20). |
| `stackable` | boolean | `false` | Several units share one inventory entry. |
| `maxStack` | integer 1–9999 | — | Units shown per stack (display chunking only, ADR-0003); required when stackable, forbidden otherwise. |
| `weightClass` | `"light"` \| `"medium"` \| `"heavy"` | `"light"` | Impact noise and physics when dropped or thrown; never carried weight (ADR-0003). |
| `worldProperties` | object | — | World properties when dropped or thrown (an oil flask is flammable). |
| `worldProperties.material` | ref → material | — | Material preset id (a material content entry). |
| `worldProperties.temperature` | number -273.15–10000 | — | Current temperature, °C. |
| `worldProperties.flammable` | boolean | — | Fire can ignite it. |
| `worldProperties.ignitionPoint` | number -273.15–10000 | — | Temperature at which it ignites, °C. |
| `worldProperties.fuel` | number 0–86400 | — | Seconds of burning left. |
| `worldProperties.burning` | boolean | — | On fire right now. |
| `worldProperties.wetness` | number 0–1 | — | How soaked it is (dry … saturated), 0 … 1. |
| `worldProperties.frozen` | boolean | — | Frozen solid. |
| `worldProperties.freezePoint` | number -273.15–10000 | — | Temperature at or below which it freezes, °C. |
| `worldProperties.conductive` | boolean | — | Conducts electric charge. |
| `worldProperties.charge` | number 0–1000000 | — | Stored electric charge. |
| `worldProperties.weight` | number 0–1000000 | — | Mass, kg. |
| `worldProperties.fragile` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Impact energy that breaks it, J. |
| `worldProperties.hp` | number 0–1000000 | — | Structural hit points. |
| `worldProperties.density` | number 0.01–100000 | — | Density, kg/m³; below 1000 it floats in water. |
| `worldProperties.climbable` | `"none"` \| `"ladder"` \| `"rope"` \| `"ivy"` \| `"rough"` \| `"sheer"` | — | Climbing grade: none, ladder, rope, ivy (easy), rough (needs a climber), sheer (needs a tool). |
| `worldProperties.liftable` | boolean | — | Can be picked up and carried. |
| `worldProperties.pushable` | boolean | — | Can be pushed or dragged. |
| `worldProperties.hideable` | boolean | — | An actor can hide in or behind it. |
| `worldProperties.reflective` | boolean | — | Reflects light beams and bolts. |
| `worldProperties.transparent` | boolean | — | Light and sight pass through it. |
| `worldProperties.opaque` | boolean | — | Fully blocks light and sight. |
| `worldProperties.lightEmitter` | object | — | Emits light. |
| `worldProperties.lightEmitter.intensity` | number 0–100000 | required | Light output (a torch is about 100). |
| `worldProperties.lightEmitter.radius` | number 0–100 | required | Reach, m. |
| `worldProperties.soundDamping` | number 0–1 | — | Fraction of sound it absorbs, 0 … 1. |
| `worldProperties.friction` | number 0–2 | — | Surface friction coefficient. |
| `worldProperties.impactAbsorb` | number 0–1 | — | Fraction of impact energy it absorbs, 0 … 1. |
| `worldProperties.owner` | id | — | Ownership tag (faction or owner id). |
| `worldProperties.liquid` | boolean | — | A liquid: it pours, puddles and can have a water surface. |
| `worldProperties.flammableGas` | boolean | — | A gas that ignites (flares or explodes) when fire reaches it. |
| `worldProperties.extinguishable` | boolean | — | A fire or light source that water, force or an interaction puts out. |
| `worldProperties.waterSurface` | boolean | — | Top surface of a body of liquid: cold freezes it into walkable ice (needs a liquid material). |
| `worldProperties.unstable` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Force of one push, blast or quake that topples it, J. |
| `worldProperties.suspended` | boolean | — | Hangs from its support; falls when the support breaks, burns or is cut. |
| `worldProperties.support` | integer ≥ 0 | — | Entity a suspended object hangs from (0 = none); set when the level spawns. |
| `worldProperties.breakable` | boolean | — | A single hit at or above its toughness for that kind of hit breaks it. |
| `worldProperties.toughness` | object | — | Per kind of hit, the single-hit energy that breaks a breakable object; a kind left out never does. |
| `worldProperties.toughness.blunt` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Blunt hit energy that breaks it, J. |
| `worldProperties.toughness.slash` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Slash hit energy that breaks it, J. |
| `worldProperties.toughness.pierce` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Pierce hit energy that breaks it, J. |
| `worldProperties.toughness.force` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Force (blast, quake, boulder) energy that breaks it, J. |
| `worldProperties.bashable` | boolean | — | A shield bash or kick shoves it (or breaks it when breakable). |
| `worldProperties.cuttable` | boolean | — | Slash or pierce damage severs it. |
| `worldProperties.shootable` | number 0–1000000 | — | Projectile impulse that fires its signal, N·s. |
| `worldProperties.softAnchor` | boolean | — | Rope arrows and hooks embed in it. |
| `worldProperties.surfaceHardness` | `"soft"` \| `"medium"` \| `"hard"` | — | Footstep loudness and whether arrows stick (soft, medium) or ricochet (hard). |
| `worldProperties.chargeActivated` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Stored charge at which the mechanism fires. |
| `worldProperties.lightActivated` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Light level on it at which the mechanism fires. |
| `worldProperties.hidden` | boolean | — | Not perceivable or targetable until revealed. |
| `worldProperties.trapped` | boolean | — | Interacting with it triggers its trap unless disarmed first (needs a trap). |
| `worldProperties.trap` | id | — | Trap definition id a trapped object triggers. |
| `worldProperties.container` | boolean | — | Holds items (contents live in the e18 container component). |
| `worldProperties.remains` | boolean | — | Inert skeletal or corpse remains that summoning can raise. |
| `worldProperties.noiseMultiplier` | number 0.2–3 | — | Multiplier on its wearer's noise; an actor's is the product of its equipment's. |
| `grants` | list of object | `[]` | Capabilities the item grants while equipped or carried (ADR-0004). |
| `grants[].capability` | string | required | Capability id declared in src/content/data/capability/, e.g. "spell.mage-hand". |
| `grants[].while` | `"equipped"` \| `"carried"` | required | When the player has it: while the item is equipped (an equipment:<id> source), or while it is carried, e.g. a tool on the belt (ADR-0004). |
| `grants[].crossClass` | boolean | — | Any class gains it through this item, e.g. a crowbar’s pry (ADR-0004 "simple" rule); default false. |
| `use` | list of object | — | Effects of using it; absent = no use. |
| `use[].op` | `"restore"` | required |  |
| `use[].pool` | `"health"` \| `"stamina"` \| `"mana"` | required |  |
| `use[].amount` | integer > 0 ≤ 1000 | required | Points restored. |
| `use[].op` | `"stat-step"` | required |  |
| `use[].amount` | `10` | required | Always +10 (ADR-0004 P5). |
| `use[].op` | `"learn"` | required |  |
| `use[].capability` | string | required | Capability id declared in src/content/data/capability/, e.g. "spell.mage-hand". |
| `use[].op` | `"status"` | required |  |
| `use[].status` | id | required | Status id, e.g. "warded" (the condition DSL reads it, mw-e22). |
| `use[].seconds` | number > 0 ≤ 3600 | required | How long it lasts, seconds. |
| `use[].op` | `"coat"` | required |  |
| `use[].properties` | object | required | World properties the weapon’s strikes carry, e.g. { "flammable": true } for oil. |
| `use[].properties.material` | ref → material | — | Material preset id (a material content entry). |
| `use[].properties.temperature` | number -273.15–10000 | — | Current temperature, °C. |
| `use[].properties.flammable` | boolean | — | Fire can ignite it. |
| `use[].properties.ignitionPoint` | number -273.15–10000 | — | Temperature at which it ignites, °C. |

| `flags.noDrop` | boolean | — | Cannot be dropped or thrown. Default: questItem. |

An entry is exactly one of the objects below: the fields above, plus those of its option.

## 1. A weapon. Weightless for load (ADR-0003): its heft is in its moves.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `"weapon"` | required |  |
| `equip` | object | required | How it is equipped. |
| `equip.slot` | `"main-hand"` \| `"off-hand"` \| `"both-hands"` | required | Slot it is worn or held in: main-hand, off-hand, both-hands. |
| `equip.proficiencies` | list of id | `[]` | Class proficiency tags it calls for, e.g. "blades", "heavy-armor" (class data, mw-e19.4). Soft: any class may equip it (mw-e17.4). |
| `equip.nonProficient` | object | `{"drawTimeMultiplier":1.5,"staminaCostMultiplier":1.25,"noiseMultiplier":1}` | The penalty while worn by a class lacking any of its proficiencies (soft proficiency, mw-e17.4): the equip succeeds and the wearer pays this instead. |
| `equip.nonProficient.drawTimeMultiplier` | number 1–3 | `1.5` | Multiplier on the time to draw, ready or raise it (combat reads it, mw-e04/mw-e05). 1 = no penalty; default 1.5. |
| `equip.nonProficient.staminaCostMultiplier` | number 1–3 | `1.25` | Multiplier on the stamina its moves cost (combat reads it, mw-e04). 1 = no penalty; default 1.25. |
| `equip.nonProficient.noiseMultiplier` | number 1–3 | `1` | Multiplier on the wearer’s noise, on top of the load class (clamped with it, ADR-0003). 1 = no penalty; default 1. |
| `weapon` | object | required | Weapon data. |
| `weapon.moves` | list of ref → move | — | Moves it adds to the wielder’s moveset; its heft lives there (mw-e04). |

## 2. An armor piece for the head, body, hands or feet.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `"armor"` | required |  |
| `equip` | object | required | How it is equipped. |
| `equip.slot` | `"head"` \| `"body"` \| `"hands"` \| `"feet"` | required | Slot it is worn or held in: head, body, hands, feet. |
| `equip.proficiencies` | list of id | `[]` | Class proficiency tags it calls for, e.g. "blades", "heavy-armor" (class data, mw-e19.4). Soft: any class may equip it (mw-e17.4). |
| `equip.nonProficient` | object | `{"drawTimeMultiplier":1.5,"staminaCostMultiplier":1.25,"noiseMultiplier":1}` | The penalty while worn by a class lacking any of its proficiencies (soft proficiency, mw-e17.4): the equip succeeds and the wearer pays this instead. |
| `equip.nonProficient.drawTimeMultiplier` | number 1–3 | `1.5` | Multiplier on the time to draw, ready or raise it (combat reads it, mw-e04/mw-e05). 1 = no penalty; default 1.5. |
| `equip.nonProficient.staminaCostMultiplier` | number 1–3 | `1.25` | Multiplier on the stamina its moves cost (combat reads it, mw-e04). 1 = no penalty; default 1.25. |
| `equip.nonProficient.noiseMultiplier` | number 1–3 | `1` | Multiplier on the wearer’s noise, on top of the load class (clamped with it, ADR-0003). 1 = no penalty; default 1. |
| `armor` | object | required | Armor data. |
| `armor.weightKg` | number > 0 ≤ 20 | required | Weight counted towards the wearer’s load. Kilograms (ADR-0003). |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `"shield"` | required |  |

| `equip.slot` | `"off-hand"` | required | Slot it is worn or held in: off-hand. |
| `equip.proficiencies` | list of id | `[]` | Class proficiency tags it calls for, e.g. "blades", "heavy-armor" (class data, mw-e19.4). Soft: any class may equip it (mw-e17.4). |
| `equip.nonProficient` | object | `{"drawTimeMultiplier":1.5,"staminaCostMultiplier":1.25,"noiseMultiplier":1}` | The penalty while worn by a class lacking any of its proficiencies (soft proficiency, mw-e17.4): the equip succeeds and the wearer pays this instead. |
| `equip.nonProficient.drawTimeMultiplier` | number 1–3 | `1.5` | Multiplier on the time to draw, ready or raise it (combat reads it, mw-e04/mw-e05). 1 = no penalty; default 1.5. |
| `equip.nonProficient.staminaCostMultiplier` | number 1–3 | `1.25` | Multiplier on the stamina its moves cost (combat reads it, mw-e04). 1 = no penalty; default 1.25. |
| `equip.nonProficient.noiseMultiplier` | number 1–3 | `1` | Multiplier on the wearer’s noise, on top of the load class (clamped with it, ADR-0003). 1 = no penalty; default 1. |
| `shield` | object | required | Shield data. |
| `shield.weightKg` | number > 0 ≤ 20 | required | Weight counted towards the wearer’s load. Kilograms (ADR-0003). |
| `shield.profile` | ref → shield | required | What a block with it does (mw-e04.6). |

## 4. Ammunition. Must be stackable.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `"ammo"` | required |  |
| `ammo` | object | required | Ammunition data. |
| `ammo.arrow` | ref → arrow | required | The arrow it fires as (mw-e05). |

## 5. A book, note or scroll the player reads.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `"book"` | required |  |
| `book` | object | required | Book data. |
| `book.textKey` | string | required | Localisation key of the readable text. |
| `book.teaches` | list of string | `[]` | Capabilities studying it can teach, as a learned book source (ADR-0004). |

## 6. A key. Lives on the keyring (mw-e17.5).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `"key"` | required |  |
| `key` | object | required | Key data: opens and/or opensTag. |
| `key.opens` | list of id | `[]` | Lock ids it opens (mw-e17.5 keyring). |
| `key.opensTag` | id | — | A master key: opens every lock with this tag. |
| `key.singleUse` | boolean | `false` | Consumed when it opens a lock. |

## 7. A consumable: using it spends one unit. Needs at least one use effect.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `"consumable"` | required |  |

## 12. Anything else.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `"misc"` | required |  |
